## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ⚡ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix or hardening
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code refactoring or style cleanup

## Security & Verification Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and PEP 8 guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have verified that **NO API keys, bot tokens, or private secrets** are included in this PR.
- [ ] I have verified that any new user input is properly bounds-checked and sanitized.
- [ ] I have tested these changes on a live test Discord server.
- [ ] All CI/CD security and SAST checks pass.
